title: SWE-Serve: benchmarking agentic engineering for production inference serving
gist: 53 tasks rebuilt from real merged SGLang pull requests, graded with hidden tests, end-to-end serving tests and performance gates.
changes: Quantifies the gap between a patch that passes unit tests and one that survives real serving: about a third of otherwise-passing patches fail once end-to-end checks are added.
caveats: Only three tasks have performance gates and their pass rates are not reported, so it says little about optimisation as such. One engine, no multi-GPU.

numbers.metric: Best agents, mean first-try pass rate
Pass rate on tasks with end-to-end tests

bears_on.note: A third of patches that look done fail real serving.
Agents handle most real serving-engine tasks, and fewer once tested properly.
